Data center operator Firmus Grid started premarketing on Thursday for an ASX IPO of about A$7B,
reported, citing unidentified people with knowledge of the matter.
A term sheet sent to investors on Monday said the institutional bookbuild would start on October 6 and close on October 7, with a prospectus expected to ​be lodged on October 8.
Retail investors will be able to bid ​for stock from October 12 to 19, the term sheet showed, as per reports.
The company, founded in 2019 by Oliver Curtis, Tim Rosenfield, and Jonathan Levee, could raise up to $5.5B, with an over-allotment option, or a so-called greenshoe, to raise ​an extra $500M.

title: Nvidia-backed Firmus Grid begins premarketing for A$7B ASX IPO: report
